name: Tidio
description: Tidio is a customer-service platform for live chat, helpdesk ticketing, contacts, operators, automation, conversational AI, and support workflows.
agentUseSummary: Enter one customer-owned Tidio OpenAPI client keypair, then let selected agents use content-free ticket operations or approved documented OpenAPI requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: TIDIO_OPENAPI_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Tidio OpenAPI client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the customer-generated OpenAPI client ID (prefixed ci_).

credentialRequirements.name: TIDIO_OPENAPI_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Tidio OpenAPI client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the secret from the same OpenAPI keypair (prefixed cs_).

capabilities.label: Read ticket operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded ticket operational metadata without subjects, messages, internal notes, contacts, names, emails, phones, custom fields, tags, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Tidio OpenAPI
capabilities.description: Use documented fixed-origin OpenAPI paths and methods allowed by the connected client keypair.

approvalRequired.label: List ticket metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free Tidio ticket summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read ticket metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Tidio ticket through Relay's content-free projection, discarding messages and customer data.

approvalRequired.label: Use OpenAPI
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Tidio OpenAPI operation authorized by the connected client keypair; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free ticket reads and every broader OpenAPI operation require approval; fixed origin, secret isolation, provider plan/access, and bounds remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected keypair-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin, secret isolation, bounds, audits, and Tidio plan/access controls still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted client keypair only to the fixed api.tidio.com origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted client keypair only to the fixed api.tidio.com origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Tidio project with OpenAPI plan access and client keypair is required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A project owner or admin generates an OpenAPI keypair, enters it in Relay, and verifies bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader-operation behavior, plan restrictions, key rotation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Tidio's official guide documents project owner/admin-generated client keypairs and the X-Tidio-Openapi-Client-Id and X-Tidio-Openapi-Client-Secret headers against api.tidio.com.
Tidio's official reference documents a cursor-paginated ticket list without messages on the fixed /tickets endpoint.
Tidio documents exact ticket retrieval including messages; Relay discards those messages and exposes only a content-free operational projection.
Tidio documents current plan restrictions for OpenAPI endpoints, making customer plan access part of live acceptance.
